Name: Chileab
Summary: Chileab, David's second son by Abigail, was born at Hebron. He is named among David's six sons born there and then disappears from the record.
KeyStory: Chileab, son of Abigail, was David's second son, born at Hebron.
LifeLesson: Some sons of kings are named once — and the record still counts them.
